# v1.21.0 Development — Detection Intelligence

**Release status:** unreleased development after v1.20.1  
**Production baseline before this work:** v1.20.1 / `2dad3060aa1a2093b8e11c50cc701e984ba0b24e`

v1.21 is intentionally being built as small PRs with full firmware, host-test and
emulator validation between substantial stages. The older
`feature/v1.21-detection-intelligence` branch is retained only as a design/reference
branch; it is not the merge source.

## Stage A — Detection evidence + RSSI trend

Merged through PR #19.

- Added compact evidence kinds for BLE manufacturer ID, service UUID, name,
  Find My payload, iBeacon payload, Wi-Fi OUI, SSID, Pwnagotchi, evil-twin and
  deauth detections.
- Added a uniform saturating `Detection::repeats` sighting count. DEAUTH keeps
  raw frame count in `hits` while `repeats` counts qualifying bursts.
- Added eight allocation-free RSSI samples at the existing ~2.048-second cadence
  (~15 seconds total) with LEARNING / APPROACHING / STEADY / MOVING AWAY states.
- ALERT shows the match source, live trend and sparkline. LOG shows compact
  evidence/repeat information. MORE INFO adds a concrete evidence page.
- Existing fixed BlackBox, SD log and NVS formats were not changed. Historical
  BlackBox rows explicitly report that Stage A evidence/trend was not persisted.
- ESP32 `Detection` size moved from 56 to 72 bytes. The validated Stage A build
  added about 1.8 KB static RAM overall while retaining substantial headroom.
- Full firmware matrix, host tests and native/WASM emulator regression passed
  before merge.

## Stage B — Per-type alert rules

This stage adds a four-byte persisted rule per `DetectionType`:

- full alert ON/OFF (OFF is LOG ONLY; detection remains counted and recorded),
- minimum confidence: GLOBAL / ALL / MED+ / HIGH,
- minimum repeats: 1 / 2 / 3 / 5,
- cooldown: OFF / 30 sec / 1 min / 5 min / 15 min,
- wake screen ON/OFF beneath the existing global wake-on-alert setting.

Defaults preserve v1.20.1 behavior: full alert ON, GLOBAL confidence, one repeat,
cooldown OFF and wake ON.

Implementation notes:

- Repeat-threshold readiness reuses the engine's existing
  `_latest/_latestChangeMs` event timestamp; no per-detection alert-ready
  timestamp is added.
- Per-type cooldown shares `Detection::lastAlertMs` with AUTO SNOOZE because
  both track the last real interruption.
- WATCH retains v1.20.1 semantics. It bypasses AUTO SNOOZE only; its dedicated
  WATCH_ALERT path remains separate from ordinary signature-alert rules.
- The experimental per-type HAPTIC/NOTIFY flag was deliberately not carried
  forward. T-Watch keeps its existing global buzz control.
- The Alert Rules UI is included in both native and WASM emulator source lists.

## Planned later stages

### Stage C — Device Policies

Planned policies: NORMAL / IGNORE / TRUSTED / ALWAYS ALERT.

The clean design uses an 8-byte core record (MAC + type + policy), not the
experimental 24-byte always-allocated alias record. Migration from older
`macs` / `dev` storage must verify the new write before deleting old keys.

### Stage D — Detection Timeline

The chronological event view will be integrated as an EVENTS mode inside the
existing LOG screen and will reuse its BlackBox page cache. This avoids a second
persistent event database, a second history page buffer and an otherwise dead
standalone Timeline app state.

### Stage E — RSSI trend polish

Stage A already supplies the data and ALERT sparkline. Any remaining Stage E work
is UI refinement rather than another storage/data feature.
